blind.description: A stylized wooden pillory consisting of a cross-shaped wooden timber base with four angled braces secured by riveted metal brackets, a central vertical square post with a metal collar, and a horizontal head-and-wrist restraint board. The horizontal restraint is split into two halves with three circular openings (a larger central neck opening flanked by two smaller wrist openings), held together by a pair of heavy iron hinges on one side and a metal clasp secured with a brass padlock on the other. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with rich brown wood grain textures and dark iron fittings, resting stably on its own timber cross-base directly on the floor.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it resembles a cross formed by the horizontal restraint board and the four extending arms of the timber base, with the square end of the central post in the middle, bracketed braces radiating outward, and metal hinges/lock details on the lateral tips.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.2 feet (1.3 m) tall, reaching approximately chest height on the 5 ft 9 in figure, with a restraint bar width of around 3.5 feet (1.1 m).

notes: footprint proportion 1.54x off the catalog (5.2 x 4.5 ft)
